title: Prior image
responsibility: Shows an earlier committed design image without annotation controls.

inputs.name: PriorImage.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace used by the image-URL helper to load the earlier image.

inputs.name: PriorImage.entityId
inputs.description: Required entity identifier for the image request.

inputs.name: PriorImage.version
inputs.description: Required earlier version, used in the request and Before caption.

inputs.name: PriorImage.sha256
inputs.description: Required image hash for the request; the component does not choose which image is earlier.

inputs.name: PriorImage.title
inputs.description: Required alternative text for the image.

outputs.name: PriorImage
outputs.description: Figure labeled Before and the supplied version. Shows the returned image or Loading earlier image. Ignores the helper’s error argument, so a failure can remain indistinguishable from loading.
